name: trefoil_t23_twist1
description: T(2,3) trefoil + framing ring (twist=1). Ring PERSISTS 24k locked steps as det-1 zero-net-linking satellite; dE=+740 vs untwisted twin at matched steps (framing raises the energy; same sign as the mirror twin)
validity: 24k steps: phi1=[(662,3),(224,1)] both components stable; Lk_total=-3.000 (ring nets ~0 = neutral dressing); Q healed to -2.71; el 6317-spike stripped to ~45 stable; E descending -37/1k like twin. Not full 36k pre-reg treatment.
caveats: engine-static: stationary only under the recorded integrator (outline §5); re-settle in any other stepper
